headings.strategy: Aggressive, tight-tracking for tech authority. H1 max text-5xl to text-6xl. font-black for hero.

body.strategy: High legibility, editorial standard, leading-relaxed for long-form reading.

mono.strategy: Category labels, meta information, dates. tracking-[0.2em] uppercase.

logo.instructions: Build with pure CSS/HTML. 'STRATOTOS' in Outfit font-black text-3xl tracking-tighter text-white. 'SYSTEM' below it (or right next to it in a pill) in JetBrains Mono text-xs tracking-widest text-[#00E5FF].

layouts.hero: TETRIS GRID (MODE A). Asymmetrical bento grid. gap-4 or gap-6. Dominant article takes col-span-full md:col-span-8 row-span-2, supporting articles take col-span-4.
layouts.news_feed: GRID BORDERS (The 'Technical' Look). Dense layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Border-b and border-r between items. No floating cards. Pure editorial flow.
layouts.sap_consulting: Premium block. Use THE TRACING BEAM or subtle glow to differentiate from news. Deep blue ambient tint behind the section.
layouts.academy: Course listings using crisp, sharp corner cards (border-radius 0). Deep hover effects.
layouts.admin: MODE B: High Density Grid. Sidebar navigation. Data-heavy layout with pure black backgrounds and #1A1A24 borders. High contrast.

components.navigation: Sticky top bar. MUST use backdrop-blur-xl and bg-[#05050A]/70. Never fully transparent. Clear brand logo on left, links center, Subscribe/Admin CTA right.
components.buttons: Sharp edges. bg-[#00E5FF] text-black font-bold hover:bg-white hover:text-black transition-colors.
components.news_card: HTML/Tailwind raw layout. Image container with overflow-hidden and hover:scale-105. Text below image. Avoid Shadcn standard 'Card'.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select. bg-[#0F0F14] border-[#1A1A24] focus:border-[#00E5FF].

motion.scrolling: Implement @studio-freight/lenis or framer-motion scroll wrappers if possible for smooth editorial feel.
motion.interactions: Hover states must brighten colors. Images in grids must slightly scale up on parent hover.

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='news-article-link', data-testid='submit-consulting').
CRITICAL: Do NOT use complete 'transparent' background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it. ALWAYS use a solid color or backdrop-blur with a semi-transparent background.
CRITICAL: Make sure guidelines and components are written for .js/.jsx files, not .tsx.
CRITICAL: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Text over images MUST have an overlay gradient (e.g., bg-black/50) or text-shadow.
Do NOT center align the app container. No '.App { text-align: center; }' globally.
Do NOT apply 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transitions (e.g., 'transition-colors', 'transition-transform').
Use generous spacing: Replace standard p-4 with p-6 or p-8 to give the layout breathing room, especially in the Xataka-style dense grid.
Use 'sonner' from shadcn for toast notifications.
Icons: Use 'lucide-react' (default) or install '@phosphor-icons/react' for a more editorial look.
